title: Brooklyn Bridge Sunset Walking Tour
includes: Licensed Tour guide who will engage with guests and answer questions throughout the trip.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Accessible to anyone who can handle 8,000 steps in the weather of that day.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Witness the beauty of New York City at dusk on the Brooklyn Bridge Sunset Tour. This engaging walking tour invites photographers and history enthusiasts to cross the iconic Brooklyn Bridge, capturing breathtaking views of the Manhattan skyline and the East River as the sun sets. Discover the rich history of the bridge and the stories of its builders while strolling through the charming Brooklyn Heights neighborhood, with its historic brownstones and serene tree-lined streets. The highlight is the Brooklyn Heights Promenade, offering stunning sunset vistas over the city. Conclude your adventure in DUMBO, where cobblestone streets and industrial architecture provide perfect backdrops for memorable photos.
